nodes.label: Capabilio Platform
nodes.rationale: Positioned as infrastructure between actual skill and job-market perception; resumes lie and credentials inflate, so Capabilio replaces self-reported claims with timestamped, AI-evaluated Proof artifacts.

nodes.label: Proof (Core Concept)
nodes.rationale: Every major feature must produce a verifiable artifact — a lesson completed is not a credential, a challenge executed and scored is. The system rewards doing, not watching.

nodes.label: Verification and Trust Layer
nodes.rationale: Capabilio's value proposition depends on trust — if any user can fake their skill scores, the system collapses.

nodes.label: Arena Workstations
nodes.rationale: All workstations that execute code must use real runtimes — no workstation should ever fake execution output with hardcoded mock data.

nodes.label: ELO Engine
nodes.rationale: ELO update is asymmetric by design — growth through success only, no punishment for a failed attempt, so trying never costs the user.
